question: how about the logistics experience and educaitons/
answer:
Thananjayan Aruljothy has experience as a Logistics Officer at INSEE Cement from April 2016 to October 2019. In this role, he managed SAP-based order processing, deliveries, invoicing, and operational reporting, coordinating with internal teams and transportation partners [Source 1].

In terms of education, he holds a Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT) from the University of Colombo, which he completed from 2020 to 2023. He also has a BSc in Transport & Logistics Management from the University of Moratuwa, which he earned from 2011 to 2016 [Source 1].
